items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Dave Terry was a very good arranger and he did charts for Joanie James among others.

ctx.x: Well besides Percy Faith for example, Ray Ellis was really my connection for a lot of the rock ‘n roll things. He arranged for Atlantic and he arranged for Columbia for people like I think it was the Four Freshmen. And he did a lot of different things. Generally if you got an association going with an arranger you would follow him to play for all the different labels for which he was getting his jobs. So we would get to know every studio and every combination. Well let’s see if I can think of some others in…
